front: How do average rates of change behave for linear vs. quadratic functions?
why: CED 1.3 linear vs quadratic rates of change; regularly assessed with tables.

front: How is the rate of change at a point related to average rates of change?
why: CED 1.2: rate of change at a point approximated by AROC over small intervals.

front: If $s(t)$ represents position, what is average velocity from $t = a$ to $t = b$?
why: AROC in a position context (CED 1.2/1.14); common context but not core.

front: What does concavity tell you about rate of change?
why: CED 1.3/1.4 concavity <-> rate of change increasing/decreasing; on nearly every exam.

front: What does the difference quotient represent?
why: AROC over [x, x+h]; appears in symbolic-manipulation items.

front: What does the sign of a rate of change tell you?
why: CED 1.1/1.2 increasing/decreasing vs rate of change.

front: What is the average rate of change of $f$ over $[a, b]$?
why: CED 1.2 average rate of change; on every exam.
